transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi, I'm Dora, a clinical conversational agent. Do you have any questions about your cataract surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Hi Dora, yes, I do have a few questions. First, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You can go back to light exercise, such as gardening, one week after surgery. However, you should avoid strenuous, heavy exercise, or lifting heavy objects for a month.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you for that. I also wanted to know when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes again?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: If you were using any eye drops before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it's safe to continue using them, unless you've been told otherwise.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: That's good to know, thank you. I've been feeling very sensitive to bright light lately. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.intended: It's normal for your eyes to be a bit sensitive to light as they adjust to the new lenses. If it's mild and things just seem brighter than you're used to, we'd recommend just wearing sunglasses when you're going outside. However, significant pain when it's bright or severe light sensitivity, especially if your eye is also red and painful, is not normal and may need further assessment.
transcript.delivered: It's normal for your eyes to be a bit sensitive to light as they adjust to the new lenses.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, one more. Should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It’s common for the vision to not be completely clear in the first week after your operation. But this should improve quickly and settle down over time. If your vision is still blurry, or getting significantly worse or blurry, we may need to check it to make sure it’s okay. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, I don't have any more questions. Thanks for all the helpful information!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You're welcome. So, just to confirm, all your questions have been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, they've all been answered. Thanks again for your help!
